command: cd scripts/msdb && python -I train_msdb.py --row msdb_adapt_dsp_curves --mode dsp --loss klcc --curves --dev cpu
what_is_trained: MSDB per-dataset parameters only: 10 scale-mix log weights, finalizer sigma, centre-bias weight, log priority (13); released saliency network and backbone frozen

calibration_maps: per run: the same n training maps fit the centre prior and select the post-hoc sigma
